Internal prior Kronecker-g censuses (SCOPE006/058/024/017 per admission scan) record Kronecker inner-product g-values/maxima/trajectories, a different invariant from S_{mn}-to-S_m x S_n restriction multiplicities. value.rationale: Strongest self-contained headline (complete exact 4013-entry restriction census for all factor pairs with mn<=12, plus two-row stability rows, exceptional witness mult=2 at (2,2), and certified global max 320 at (3,4)) is an exact invariant of a natural motivated object: the product-action embedding S_m x S_n -> S_{mn} over the natural all-factor-pairs window closing inside S_12, motivated before computation by the Ryba/Entova-Aizenbud stability program feeding representation-stability/plethysm/GCT multiplicity questions. Values were not known or mechanically implied (no closed form governs them; densities 45-92% and maxima up to 320 are non-obvious) and a future researcher can reasonably need the precise multiplicities/certificates for stability-threshold calibration and test suites. This is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration: every entry carries integrality/dimension/Frobenius cross-checks with archived tables and class-sum certificates. Narrowness alone does not defeat value under the shared standard.
